extracted.name: Okonomiyaki (Japanese Pancake)
extracted.description: This savory pancake filled with cabbage, bacon, sausage, and shrimp is a well known Japanese dish, okonomiyaki, that's easy to customize.
ingredient_lines: 1 sausage, diced, or more to taste
1 tablespoon vegetable oil, or to taste
1 tablespoon panko bread crumbs, or to taste
instruction_lines: Mix flour and water together in a bowl until smooth. Stir in cabbage, bacon, eggs, sausage, green onions, shrimp, cheese, and tenkasu.
Preheat a griddle to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C) and coat with oil.
Pour 1/4 of batter onto preheated griddle. Cook until golden brown, about 6 minutes per side. Transfer to a serving plate. Repeat to make a total of 4 pancakes.
Make sauce: Mix soy sauce, ketchup, and vinegar together in a small bowl. Drizzle over pancakes.
